messages.author: 5da69eb4ce1e96ed
messages.subject: Doesn't work after deploying in Shinyapps.io
parts:
https://nithin.shinyapps.io/VanFitlargefiles/ 

is the link to my Shiny app which I have deployed today. This is my first shiny application which does simple curve fit from the input file data that is fed into the R code. It works absolutely fine on my local computer on R studio . But when I access it through the link, it doesn't load the data from the input file, and since everything is based on that, it does nothing and screen dims out within seconds after the application is opened. I don't know if there is an issue while it's getting deployed to shinyapp.io server. I made sure that I have re-installed all the packages that I have used in my server.R again before deploying to shinyapps.io account. Any help on this is much appreciated. I'm sorry if this is a repetitive question as I have searched the forum if I can find any article related articles but was unsuccessful. 

Thank you,
Nithin
